## INTEGRATIONS FAQs

#### What types of systems can Orange Logic integrate with?

Orange Logic connects DAM content and workflows with creative tools, CMS platforms, marketing systems, AI services, enterprise applications, and other technologies. Organizations can use ready-to-use Marketplace integrations or extend the platform through APIs, SDKs, webhooks, MCP, and embedded content experiences.

#### Can Orange Logic automate workflows across connected systems?

Yes. Content events can trigger workflows and actions across connected applications, while Orange Logic orchestration coordinates people, systems, AI, and agents. Permissions, approvals, and governance can remain connected throughout the process.

#### How does Orange Logic work with Adobe Creative Cloud?

Orange Logic lets creative teams work with governed DAM assets directly from Adobe and other desktop applications. File on Demand streams large files without full downloads or duplicate copies, then saves edits back to the DAM as governed versions.

#### How does Orange Logic integrate with AEM, Contentstack, Contentful, and other CMS platforms?

Orange Logic provides integrations for AEM, Contentstack, and Contentful that bring approved DAM assets into publishing workflows while preserving metadata, permissions, and governance. The Content Browser SDK can also embed DAM search, transformation, and delivery into other content applications.

#### How does a DAM integrate with a PIM system?

A DAM and PIM can exchange product assets, metadata, and workflow actions so product information stays connected to approved content. Orange Logic can support these architectures through APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and orchestration rather than requiring every PIM connection to follow one integration model.

#### Can developers build custom integrations with Orange Logic?

Yes. Orange Logic provides APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and MCP so developers can access governed content and metadata, embed DAM experiences, trigger workflows and actions, and connect the platform to custom enterprise applications.

#### Does Orange Logic support integrations with AI agents?

Yes. Orange Logic supports MCP for exposing approved content context, tools, and actions to agents. Agents can participate in workflows while operating within the permissions, governance, and business context applied to enterprise content.
